verdict.rationale: Better Auth documents configurable session expiry (`expiresIn`, default 7 days) and sliding refresh via `updateAge`, plus a refresh flow where GET returns `needsRefresh` and the client POSTs to refresh. Its security reference also says logged-in users can revoke their own sessions on other devices and browsers. missing for 10: explicit docs for admin- or server-initiated revocation of a specific compromised session, confirmation that revocation takes effect immediately (e.g. with any session caching), and independent hands-on corroboration.
